heroHeadline: DNA-Guided CRISPR Paradigm Shift Published; Scribe ASGCT NHP Data: Zero Off-Target Effects; Beam Risto-cel BLA on Track; Casgevy 500+ Patients Globally
heroSubtitle: May 19, 2026: Two independent research groups (University of Florida; HKUST) published landmark DNA-guided CRISPR findings in Nature Biotechnology, overturning the RNA-guide dogma established by Doudna and Charpentier in 2012 — DNA guides offer superior chemical stability for diagnostics and future therapeutic applications. May 18, 2026: Scribe Therapeutics released ASGCT 2026 oral session data showing its ELXR epigenetic silencer and XE editor achieved saturating in vivo liver editing in non-human primates with zero detectable off-target effects at 10× the EC90 dose — leading three cardiometabolic programs (LDL-C, Lp(a), triglycerides) toward IND. May 20, 2026: Beam Therapeutics confirmed risto-cel BLA submission on track for year-end 2026, with BEACON long-term biomarker data heading to EHA 2026 (June) and $1.2B cash runway. Casgevy commercial ramp: 500+ patients initiated treatment globally, $43M Q1 2026 revenue for CRISPR Therapeutics.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA, EMA, MHRA, NIH, peer-reviewed journals (Nature, Science, NEJM, Cell), ClinicalTrials.gov, and major science outlets. Clinical data reflects published peer-reviewed results only.
